wedgeSits.name: A person, maybe 20s, with a broad frame
Sung
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Wait — I'm away from Haven, out on the road. I can't promise a dawn meet while I'm out — find me when I'm back, and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Marisol
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Then it’s set. Where the greenbrier shoots grows thick, at sunup. Pack and knife. We travel light."

wedgeSits.name: Marisol
wedgeSits.actionLine: Marisol falls in beside you. "Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground. Let us go find the green."

wedgeSits.name: Marisol
wedgeSits.actionLine: Marisol shrugs, hands empty of anything edible. "Nothing we can eat here — wood and green we cannot name yet. We keep walking."
